citations.claim: cart exceeds 2.4m track at first violating step
cart already near edge and moving outward 5 steps before violation

explanation: Controller prioritizes pole upright (theta stays ~0.06 rad) but allows steady cart drift with v~1.3 m/s outward; with coarse dt=0.02 and light cart/heavy long pole, drift accumulates until x exceeds 2.4 m at step 195.

violation.detail: cart at x=2.401 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The blue cart drifts steadily rightward along the track while the pole on top stays nearly upright. By step 195 the cart reaches the far right end of the track and goes out of bounds.
